name: @splrad/steward
description: Central repository automation for SPLRAD projects.

scripts.test: uv sync --project tools/template --frozen --only-group release-inspection --inexact --no-build && npm run test:pages && vitest run
scripts.verify: npm run test && npm run typecheck && npm run verify:config && npm run verify:dist && npm run verify:workflows
scripts.test:template: uv run --project tools/template --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tools/template -p test_*.py -v
